How is it coming?
You can collect Colon Leaves and defeat\nBoss Colon [ffff64]here on the land under development[ffffff].
Boss Colon is strong just like its name but\nI'm sure you can foresee its special moves.\nYou can do it.
How to evade the special moves?\nYou'll see [ff6464]a red circle[ffffff] on the floor, so\nyou just have to [ffff64]get out of the circle[ffffff].
I'm glad to see you're safe!\nYou defeated Boss Colon! Congratulations!
And you just have to collect 5 Colon Leaves.\nKeep up the good work!
You can get Colon Leaves from [ffff64]Colons[ffffff]\n[ffff64]on the land under development[ffffff].
You've defeated Boss Colon, so it should be easy.
Noooooo!
Ouch... Oh, thank you.\nI'm alright. I was just off guard...
Triel! You okay?! Hey! You!
Yes! You! Help us out!\nHuh?! We've gotta defeat the monsters!
EVENT BATTLE\nDefeat all the Colons!
Balft! You okay?
Yea, I'm alright.
Hm? You look like a stranger here.\nWho are you!
Balft! That's too rude...
...Mmm, yea, you're right. I'm sorry.\nLet us introduce ourselves first.\nI'm Balft and this is my sister Triel.
We're taking up lodging in this city and hunting\nmonsters on the land under development and ruins\nto make money for our travel.
So, may I have your name?
...I see. You're Straye, too?\nIt would be nice if we could... Oh?
Look, Balft!\nThis traveler doesn't have the badge.
What?! ...Hmm.\nHey, where's your badge? Don't know what it is?!\nWere you raised by wolves or something?!
That's going too far, Balft.\nLooks like this traveler hasn't heard of it.
But you know Straye refers to the people who are\ntraveling all over the world looking for\ntheir life purpose, don't you?
We, Straye people are traveling with the help of\nthe supporters and other people but...
You need to have a badge to identify yourself as\nan official Straye person.
Didn't know that? You're so ignorant.\nAlright, I got back the badges from the bandits\nthe other day, so I can give you one.
No, no, I can't give you for free.\nGet 5 herbs from the plant-like creatures here.
And, there's a Colon that looks like the leader\nof the monsters here. Defeat it, too.
Hey, don't risk your life, okay?\nIt'll leave a bad taste in my mouth if you die\nbecause of my order.
Please be careful...
Wow, that was fast!
Was it too hard just as I thought?\nDon't worry, I...
What?!\nYou have the herbs?!
And you defeated the leader of the monsters?!\nYou got me.\nNow I'll fulfill my promise.
Let's perform the ceremony. Sorry, but it's\nsimplified. In the names of the twelve gods,\nthou shalt receive a Straye badge.
That's it. Hey?\nNow you are the owner of this badge.
Congratulations!\nYou are a Straye from now on.\nRight, Balft?
Good for you. You must be honored to... Ouch!\n...Ha ha, it's nothing.
To tell the truth, we were asked to collect\nthe herbs by a synthesist, Mubia in the city.
Can you deliver them to Mubia and get the pay?
Balft! You're asking too much!
O, oh! I apol...\nNo no! I mean, sorry Triel!
But we can't leave this place because we were\nrequested to guard it.
We received the pay in advance, so...
Is that OK for you? I gotta scold him later...\nThank you so much.
This is my territory!\nHow dare you hunt my minions here?!\nI'll knock you out of here!
Mmm!\nLooks like [ffff64]you haven't used your stat points[ffffff]!
You think you can beat me now? Ha!
No matter how high your level is, you won't\nbecome strong like me unless you distribute\nyour stat points!
The battle could be tough if you begin the battle\nnow. [64ffff]Raise your character stats from the Menu on\nthe upper left of the screen[ffffff] before the challenge!
The battle could be tough if you begin the battle\nnow. [64ffff]Raise your character stats from the Menu on\nthe bottom right of the screen[ffffff] before the challenge!
Fight later
Fight now
BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Boss Colon!!
Ugg... Y-You've got me...
I apologize for the trouble.\nBalft, don't you have something to say?
Uh... I'm so sorry.
...What? Oh, the pay for the herbs?\nThanks.
It's not really much but please receive the money.
Hey, that's too much, Triel!
It was the traveler that collected the herbs.\nNot us.
Ggg... Fine.\nTake that money!
Somebody heeeeelp!!
What happened?!
We found a golem in perfect condition but...
This stupid guy connected the cable before\nwe use the control magic! And the golem woke up\ngoing out of control!
What did you say?!\nI asked thousands of times if you used the magic!
You just gave me vague answers and that's why\nit happened!!
Enough! You both are responsible for that!!\nSorry to bother you but, Mr. Balft, could you\nstop the golem so it won't get out?
We'll find the way to turn off the golem.\nYou may [ffff64]break it down if it tries to go out[ffffff]!
What?! Break it down?!\nHow long do you think it took to find a golem\nin excellent condition?!
He's right!\nWe've spent enormous time and money to...
Shut up!\nIf you don't want that, beat your brains out!
We need to hurry, Balft?
Yea... But it's in the ruins.\nIt must be too hard for just the two of us...
Hey, did you hear that?\nCan you stop the golem with us?
You look like a beginner adventurer but\nwe need all the help we can get.
Please! We need your help!
Great, thanks.\nThe golem is [ffff64]in the ruins ahead of here[ffffff].
You'll see it's quite strange inside the ruins.\nEven skilled scholars get lost there.
First, we search for the golem.\nWhen you find the golem, call us. ...You got it?\nAlright, Let's go!
Hey there, adventurer!\nYou distributed your [ffff64]stat points[ffffff]?
Stat Points...?
Sure.
You can get [ffff64]Stat Points[ffffff] everytime you level up.
You [ffff64]need to distribute Stat Points to get\nstronger[ffffff].
Check your stats from Menu > Character> Stats.
That's good. [ff6464]You need to distribute Stat Points\nto get stronger[ffffff], okay?
You can check stats from Menu > Character> Stats.
